visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit retail environment, specifically a high-end cosmetics store. A woman with short dark hair, wearing glasses and a crisp white long-sleeved shirt, stands in front of a makeup display. She has a small silver bow-shaped hair clip. The background features black and white striped columns and shelves filled with various beauty products. (2) As the woman speaks, she gestures towards the makeup palettes on the display. She is holding a smartphone with a grey case and a cream-colored crocheted shawl. Her facial expression is expressive and engaging, maintaining eye contact with the camera. The store lighting is bright and even, highlighting her clear skin. (3) Graphical stickers appear on the screen periodically; first, a stylized icon of a woman with pink hair and flowers, then an icon of a girl reading a book. The camera remains mostly static at a medium shot distance, focusing on her upper body and gestures. (4) The video concludes with a transition to a clean white graphic card. This card displays the logo for 'DRX Dermatology Clinic' in grey and black. Detailed contact information including a LINE ID, phone number, and two physical addresses in Taipei and New Taipei City are neatly listed with corresponding icons.
